## Products

- [Indonesian Agarwood (Oud)](https://www.hindiatimur.com/products/agarwood/): Export-grade Indonesian agarwood (oud) resin and chips from Sumatra and Kalimantan. GC-MS certified, CITES compliant. Request a B2B quote.
- [Ambergris](https://www.hindiatimur.com/products/ambergris/): Indonesian-sourced ambergris for perfumery and fragrance. Aged, authenticated specimens for B2B buyers — tincture-ready and legally traded. Request a quote.
- [Indonesian Avocado](https://www.hindiatimur.com/products/avocado/): Export-grade Indonesian avocados. Hass and Mentega varieties from East Java highlands. Cold-chain optimized, global GAP compliant. Request a B2B quote.
- [Indonesian Cacao Beans](https://www.hindiatimur.com/products/cacao/): Export-grade Indonesian cacao: fermented, single-origin beans from Sulawesi and Bali with high fat content. Direct farm partnership. Request a quote.
- [Indonesian Cashew Nut](https://www.hindiatimur.com/products/cashew/): Indonesian cashew kernels, W180 to W450, whole and splits, from East Java and East Nusa Tenggara with full export documents. Request a B2B quote.
- [Coconut Charcoal Briquettes](https://www.hindiatimur.com/products/charcoal/): Export-grade Indonesian coconut charcoal briquettes. High heat, long burn time, low ash. Premium Shisha and BBQ grades available. Request a B2B quote.
- [Indonesian Specialty Coffee](https://www.hindiatimur.com/products/coffee/): Single-origin Indonesian specialty coffee from volcanic highlands. Export-grade Arabica and Robusta with full compliance documentation. Request a B2B quote.
- [Industrial Corncob](https://www.hindiatimur.com/products/corncob/): Indonesian corncob for industrial, agricultural and feed use: dried, ground and sized to spec. Sustainable biomass and substrate. Request a B2B quote.
- [Indonesian Fruit Chips](https://www.hindiatimur.com/products/fruit-chips/): Export-grade Indonesian fruit chips: jackfruit, banana, pineapple and more, vacuum-fried or air-dried, with full compliance documents.
- [Gula Aren (Palm Sugar)](https://www.hindiatimur.com/products/gula-aren/): Export-grade Gula Aren (Arenga palm sugar) from West Java and Sulawesi. Organic certified, low GI, granulated or block. Request a B2B quote.
- [Rawn Forest Honey](https://www.hindiatimur.com/products/honey/): Raw Indonesian forest honey (Apis dorsata), wild-harvested in Sumatra and Kalimantan. Lab-tested purity, no additives, phytosanitary certified.
- [Natural Indigo Paste](https://www.hindiatimur.com/products/indigo/): Natural Indonesian indigo paste (Indigofera tinctoria) from Central Java and Flores. Traditional extraction, high pigment, for textile dyeing.
- [Indonesian Kratom](https://www.hindiatimur.com/products/kratom/): Export-grade Indonesian kratom (Mitragyna speciosa) from Kalimantan. Lab-tested alkaloid profile, sustainably harvested. Request a B2B quote.
- [Indonesian Moringa Powder](https://www.hindiatimur.com/products/moringa/): Export-grade Indonesian Moringa oleifera powder from East Java and East Nusa Tenggara. Bulk superfood supply with full documents. Request a B2B quote.
- [Indonesian Patchouli Oil](https://www.hindiatimur.com/products/patchouli/): Indonesian patchouli oil from Sulawesi and Sumatra: PA 30–35%, GC-MS tested, light and dark grades, direct from distillers. Request a B2B quote.
- [Porang Konjac Flour](https://www.hindiatimur.com/products/porang/): Indonesian porang (Amorphophallus muelleri) konjac flour and chips from East Java and NTT. High glucomannan, lab-tested. Request a B2B quote.
- [Indonesian Red Kidney Beans](https://www.hindiatimur.com/products/red-beans/): Export-grade Indonesian Red Kidney Beans. High protein, non-GMO, sustainably farmed. Premium Grade A beans from Java highlands. Request a B2B quote.
- [Indonesian Sandalwood](https://www.hindiatimur.com/products/sandalwood/): Indonesian sandalwood (Santalum album) oil and logs from Timor and Sumba. ISO 3515, α-santalol 41–54%, CITES documents. Request a B2B quote.
- [Indonesian Sorghum](https://www.hindiatimur.com/products/sorghum/): Export-grade Indonesian sorghum from East Java and NTT. Gluten-free, nutrient-rich ancient grain for food or industrial use. Request a B2B quote.
- [Indonesian Cloves, Nutmeg & Pepper](https://www.hindiatimur.com/products/spices/): Indonesian cloves, nutmeg and pepper from Maluku and Sumatra. ABCD grades, origin-certified, direct from farm cooperatives. Request a B2B quote.
- [Indonesian Tapioca Starch](https://www.hindiatimur.com/products/tapioca/): Export-grade Indonesian tapioca (cassava) starch from Lampung and Central Java. High viscosity, low moisture, food and industrial grades.
- [Tengkawang (Illipe Butter)](https://www.hindiatimur.com/products/tengkawang/): Wild-harvested illipe butter (tengkawang) from Kalimantan's rainforests: cocoa butter substitute, cosmetic emollient and candle-grade fat.
- [Indonesian Vanilla Beans](https://www.hindiatimur.com/products/vanilla/): Indonesian vanilla beans from our own farms in North Sulawesi and East Java. Planifolia and Tahitensis, Grade A pods and extract splits. Request a quote.

## Articles

- [Indonesia's Coffee Heritage & Volcanic Terroir](https://www.hindiatimur.com/blog/coffee-heritage-volcanic/): Indonesia's coffee regions (Sumatra, Java, Sulawesi, Flores) and how volcanic soil and altitude shape export-grade specialty coffee.
- [Organic Certification & Fair Trade in Indonesia](https://www.hindiatimur.com/blog/organic-certification-fair-trade/): How we support farmers with organic certification (IMO/USDA NOP), fair trade and transparent supply chains, and what it means for importers.
- [Indonesian Produce Seasonal Availability Guide](https://www.hindiatimur.com/blog/seasonal-availability-guide/): Seasonal sourcing calendar for Indonesian exports: harvest windows for coffee, vanilla, spices, moringa and 15+ commodities to plan your orders.
- [Sustainable Coconut Farming in Indonesia](https://www.hindiatimur.com/blog/sustainable-coconut-farming/): How Indonesian coconut farmers blend tradition with sustainable practice: intercropping, organic pest control and biodiversity for export-grade output.
- [The Journey of Premium Indonesian Vanilla](https://www.hindiatimur.com/blog/vanilla-sourcing-journey/): Inside export-grade Indonesian vanilla, from hand-pollination to months of curing, and what sets Indonesian beans apart.
- [Water Conservation in Indonesian Farming](https://www.hindiatimur.com/blog/water-conservation-tropical/): How Indonesian farmers manage water in tropical agriculture: rainwater harvesting, irrigation and soil-moisture practices for sustainable exports.
